title: Stijnmarsepijn's Quality Of Life Pack
description: A pack with performance mods and Quality
body:
StijnMarsepijn's Quality of Life Performance Pack (Fabric)
This is a meticulously crafted, client-side Fabric-based performance modpack designed to give you the highest possible framerates and the smoothest gameplay experience while staying true to the vanilla aesthetic. Stop worrying about lag and start enjoying Minecraft the way it was meant to be played!

Built on the Fabric Performance Trinity
Our pack utilizes the gold standard in Minecraft optimization to ensure maximum stability and speed:

Sodium: The backbone of the pack. Replaces the default rendering engine for massive boosts in FPS, particularly when exploring or in graphically intense situations.

Lithium: Optimizes hundreds of game physics and logic functions (like mob AI and block handling) to reduce server-side (and single-player) lag and ensure stable tick rates.

Starlight: A completely rewritten lighting engine that loads chunks faster and handles light updates more efficiently than the vanilla game, often eliminating lighting-related stuttering.

Essential Quality of Life & Efficiency
Beyond the core performance boost, we've included essential mods for a better user experience:

FerriteCore: Significantly lowers the pack's RAM footprint by optimizing how assets are loaded, making the game more accessible on systems with less memory.

Entity Culling: Prevents entities (mobs, items, etc.) that are completely obscured behind solid blocks from being rendered, providing a major FPS boost in bases and crowded areas.

Mod Menu: Allows you to easily access and customize the configuration of almost every mod right from the in-game screens.

Indium: Ensures seamless compatibility between Sodium and mods that rely on the Fabric Rendering API.

Optional Eye Candy (With Performance!)
Iris Shaders: If you want to use shaders (like complementary or BSL), this mod allows you to run them efficiently alongside Sodium, giving you both high FPS and stunning visuals.

Hardcore
With this pack you can also play (multiplayer) hardcore (servers).

Compatibility
This pack is 100% client-side. You only need to install it to enjoy the benefits. It works perfectly on vanilla servers, realms, and other Fabric-based servers.

Download now and turn your lag-filled experience into a buttery-smooth adventure!
